describes: packages/plugin/annotation: comments, attached links, the script commit door, attachment download and baked appearances.

cases.name: threads-and-members
cases.covers: threads() are display-ordered (page order, then top of page, then creation); thread(ref) finds the thread of any member (root, reply, grouped part, status) and null for none. The lens reads hydration too.

cases.name: threads-off-the-layout
cases.covers: A thread on a page the layout does not list sorts last.

cases.name: reply-edit-status-marked
cases.covers: reply writes a flat /IRT to the root whatever member was passed, with the reply flags; edit patches contents through the one update path; setStatus chains to the caller’s previous status (else the root); setMarked writes the Marked model; onThreadChanged hears each verb. A measurement dimension’s contents are derived, so edit rejects. Each create syncs baked and resolves after the engine confirms. An unknown ref rejects.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] no comment thread contains this ref

cases.name: status-without-a-previous-one
cases.covers: Without a session identity, or without a previous status of the caller’s, setStatus replies to the root.

cases.name: remove-and-remove-thread
cases.covers: remove deletes one annotation. removeThread deletes children first, root last, one at a time; a member failing the delete gate blocks the whole thread up front (every blocked ref listed, nothing deleted); a mid-flight refusal stops the cascade before the root.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] no comment thread contains this ref

cases.name: comment-permissions
cases.covers: permissionsFor: reply and status are create authority; text edits are gated by lockedContents and refused on a measurement dimension, deletes by locked; the thread gate covers every member. Without create authority neither verb is offered; an unknown ref can do nothing but reply.

cases.name: attached-links
cases.covers: links.set on a committed parent creates the /RT /Group link child over its footprint and resolves once it is committed, after which links.of reads it; a second set retargets the child in place; links.clear deletes it. A read-only target is carried, never written. of on a link reads its own target, on an unknown ref null.

cases.name: links-follow-geometry-and-props
cases.covers: A committed geometry patch of a parent with children schedules a keep-sync that re-rects them toward whatever target the substrate holds. updateSelection({ link }) goes through the syncLink effect. A markup parent gets one child per quad. A failing reconcile reports to console.error.

cases.name: rapid-link-sets-chain
cases.covers: Two sets on one parent chain: the second starts after the first settles, and each reads the model at run time.

cases.name: link-sync-chains-per-parent
cases.covers: Link syncs chain per parent: a third set on one parent waits for the second, not the first; a set after the first settles still waits for the latest; and when one parent’s chain drains, another parent’s pending chain is kept, so its next set still waits.

cases.name: script-commits
cases.covers: commitScriptEffects: per entry, resolve the ref from the model (or the engine’s page list for an unloaded one), lower the Acrobat patch (RGB, gray and CMYK colours, a transparent fill as null, borderStyle, dash, rect, contents, flags, opacity, width), write it, stop on the first refusal (the rest skip), and reload each touched page once. Unresolvable entries (a loaded one without a subtype asks the page list first) and transparent strokes fail without writing; a listed page is searched for the entry’s own object number.

results.error: transparent stroke colours are not supported

cases.name: script-commits-through-actions
cases.covers: With the actions plugin present, init registers commitScriptEffects as its annotation commit sink and releases it on close.

cases.name: attachment-download
cases.covers: downloadAttachment asks the page service for the bytes and resolves with them; an unknown ref rejects.

cases.name: baked-appearances
cases.covers: appearances asks for the page’s /AP images at a scale and resolves their list; a failure resolves []. A signal already aborted aborts the request at once; one aborted later aborts it then. An unknown page throws synchronously.

cases.name: bake-scale-on-a-lattice
cases.covers: bakeScale snaps up the document’s appearance lattice and caps at its top rung.
